sourceConcerns: The source title “Symbols as Non-Enumerable Keys” misleadingly associates Symbol keys with non-enumerability. Symbol-keyed properties can be enumerable, as the source explanation correctly states. The translation faithfully preserves this inconsistency.

The source’s Object.defineProperty() explanation overgeneralizes: omitted enumerable defaults to false when creating a property, but an existing property retains its enumerability when that attribute is omitted. Its reference to “other enumeration methods” is also too broad because some property-inspection APIs include non-enumerable properties. The shown example and marked answer remain correct.
“Retrieve All Symbol Keys” and its question omit the own-property restriction of Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(); the explanation supplies that restriction. This imprecision is inherited.
The source calls for...in an enumeration “method”; it is a language statement. The translation preserves that terminology.
